pcs.pc_description: determine the job specification by referring to a valid source, such as worksheet/job card, operational drawings, approved sketches/illustrations, work drawings, instructions from the supervisor/person-in- charge, etc.
check the process sheet and match it with the received drawings and other specifications
check the availability of the required tools and measuring instruments
check the measuring instruments to ensure they are within the calibration date
select and prepare the appropriate materials, tools and equipment required for the grinding operations
check the raw material/ components to ensure they are free from foreign objects, dirt and contamination
check the post-machining sheet to determine if the component meets the applicable quality standards from the previous machining operations
mount the workpiece safely and secure it on the grinding machine
prepare the grinding wheels following the applicable methods, such as dressing, truing up, wheel forming, etc.
check for safe resting of the component on the resting pads and clamping load of fixture

grind the components to produce a variety of features such as flat, parallel, vertical, angular faces; steps and shoulders; counter, tapered, parallel bores; slots; parallel, stepped, tapered diameters; etc.
use the machine tool controls safely and correctly as per the applicable operational procedures
adjust the machine tool speed and feed rate as per the requirement
identify abnormal noises coming from the machine and component, and adjust the feed and Revolutions Per Minute (RPM), as required
check the condition of the tools being used and repair them, as required

check the quality of grinding on machined components, using the measuring instruments appropriate to the aspects being checked and the tolerances to be achieved, such as dimensional tolerance and accuracy; flatness and squareness; surface texture; etc.
ensure the machined components are free from false grinding cuts, wheel marks, burrs and sharp edges
record the measured values as per the organisational standards and complete the post- machining inspection sheet
ensure adherence to the relevant quality control procedures and International Organization for Standardization (ISO) standards concerning the grinding operations

identify issues with grinding operations such as defects caused by glazed wheels; inappropriate feeds/speeds; damage by work holding devices, and take the appropriate actions as per the Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) to resolve them
use the relevant Industry 4.0 manufacturing technologies to ensure interconnectivity, automation, machine learning, and real-time data collection and analysis
follow the manufacturer’s instructions to shut down and isolate the grinding machine safely in case of emergencies
carry out regular repair and maintenance of the grinding machine and coordinate with an expert to resolve complex issues
collect and dispose of the industrial waste in compliance with the applicable regulations and organisational procedures
use electricity and other resources optimally in various tasks and processes
connect electrical tools and equipment safely and turn them off when they are not in use
